cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Using extractall() without path validation can lead to directory traversal attacks (ZipSlip). Malicious zip files can contain paths with '../' sequences to write files outside the target directory.
Using extractall() without path validation can lead to directory traversal attacks (TarSlip). Malicious tar files can contain paths with '../' sequences to write files outside the target directory.
